tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Jan Linketscher is: managing director and shareholder of the digital agency i22 (Bonn), his background, how his texts are written, and how to contact him. Content is in German.

section.description: Limit the text answer to one section (default: all). Structured output is always complete.

tools.name: list_essays
tools.description: List the essays, newest first: title, date, one-sentence summary, topics, URL and slug. Optionally filter by topic slug. Also returns the available topics.

topic.description: Topic slug, e.g. "transformation" or "agentic-visibility". Omit for all essays.

tools.name: get_essay
tools.description: Full text of one essay as Markdown (with front matter). Use the slug from list_essays or search.

slug.description: Essay slug, e.g. "mein-essay" (the last part of /essays/<slug>).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all essays and pages (about, context). Returns the best matches with title, URL and a short snippet. German queries work best.

tools.name: list_meeting_types
tools.description: The kinds of calls that can be booked with Jan Linketscher ("kennenlernen" (Kennenlernen, 30 min), "sparring" (Sparring, 60 min)), with duration, purpose and a booking link for humans.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Free time slots for a call with Jan Linketscher. meeting_type: "kennenlernen" (Kennenlernen, 30 min), "sparring" (Sparring, 60 min). Optional date range (YYYY-MM-DD, default: the next 14 days, at most 90 days ahead). Times are ISO 8601 with offset; the text answer lists them in Europe/Berlin.

to.description: Last day (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Default: from + 13 days.

tools.name: book_meeting
tools.description: Book a call with Jan Linketscher on behalf of your user. The start must be a slot returned by get_availability. If your client supports elicitation (form mode, MCP 2026-07-28), the server itself asks the user to confirm time, name and email – name and email are then prefilled from your arguments and can be corrected by the user. Otherwise: show the user meeting type, date and time (with time zone), name and email, get their explicit approval, then pass name, email and confirmed: true. Use the user's real name and email; never invent them. Cal.com sends the confirmation with a calendar invite and links to reschedule or cancel to that email address.

name.description: Full name of the person attending.

email.description: Email of the person attending; the confirmation goes there.

notes.description: Optional: what the call is about, in one or two sentences.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone of the attendee, e.g. "Europe/Berlin" (default Europe/Berlin).

confirmed.description: Only for clients without elicitation: true = the user has explicitly approved this booking.
